starter_files.contents:
# Console Calculator

Run with `dotnet run`. Start by implementing input parsing and a pure calculation method, then add the interaction loop.

## Done when

- [ ] Parse numeric input without crashing on malformed text
- [ ] Support addition, subtraction, multiplication, and guarded division
- [ ] Allow repeated operations until the learner exits
- [ ] Separate calculation logic from console interaction
